property_summary: For any callee that either succeeds or reverts, the reference contract C forwards the callee's success (i.e., forward returns/does not revert exactly when the low-level call succeeds), whereas the mutant inverts the success flag and therefore will revert when the callee call succeeds and succeed when it reverts — violating the rule for callees that revert or succeed.
change_summary: Invert the boolean returned by call and then require that it is true by negating in assignment, causing different revert behavior.
